brief.title: From your brief to approved publishing
brief.narration: Start with a concrete brief and create the video on your computer. Watch the complete draft, check the text and listen to the voiceover. Approve only the version you want to publish. Each channel keeps its own receipt, so errors can be resumed without uploading duplicate videos.
brief.caption: Private integration test: local rendering, draft approval and verified publishing.
